name: sqlite-sql
title: SQLite SQL project
blurb: SQL reporting project on SQLite: schema with CHECK constraints, views that hold the arithmetic, one SELECT per report, a shell wrapper, assertions over exact cents
default_description: A SQL reporting project on SQLite.

verify.name: constraints
verify.cmd: set +e; sqlite3 build/app.db "INSERT INTO customers (id, name, country) VALUES (9, 'Eve', 'FR');" 2>/dev/null; status=$?; echo "exit status: $status"; test "$status" -ne 0

verify.name: cascade
verify.cmd: cp build/app.db .cascade.db; sqlite3 .cascade.db 'PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON; DELETE FROM customers WHERE id = 1;' && test "$(sqlite3 .cascade.db 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders;')" = 3 && test "$(sqlite3 .cascade.db 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items;')" = 4; status=$?; rm -f .cascade.db; exit $status
